description: This file defines an Express middleware function 'authAdmin' used to authenticate administrators via JWT tokens. It verifies the token's validity and matches its decoded value against environment variables for admin email and password. If authentication fails, it responds with an error message; otherwise, it proceeds to the next middleware.

methods.name: authAdmin
methods.description: An asynchronous middleware function that authenticates admin users by verifying JWT token from request headers and comparing its decoded value with environment variables.
